title: Label Allentown

title: Accordion Item Allentown

icon.description: Required when markerType is icon. Font Awesome 7 Sharp Solid icon name.

title: Battery Card Trinity

bestForIcon.description: Optional Font Awesome 7 Sharp Solid icon name, for example bolt or boxes-stacked.

webshopCta.description: Required webshop action for this battery model.

specificationCta.description: Optional specification download or detail action.

title: Content Hero Media Allentown
description: Reusable hero media for articles and cases. It supports an image, an S3-uploaded video, or an external video URL; video sources carry a poster image for the initial render and content cards.

sourceType.description: Select one source. The paired adapter validates the matching media field and never renders multiple source types.

image.description: Required when Source type is image. Used as the Article hero and its related-content card image.

video.description: Required when Source type is uploaded-video. Stored in the customer S3-backed Media collection.

externalVideoUrl.description: Required when Source type is external-video. The adapter validates the supported external provider URL.

poster.description: Required for either video source. Used before playback and as the Case featured image in related-content cards.
